combo_label: Capital Cities × Camping & the Outdoors × Mr Men & Little Miss

entries.clue: Home of K-pop and kimchi, spread along the broad Han River
Wedge-bladed tool swung two-handed to split logs
Danube city of waltzes, grand coffee houses and a rich chocolate sponge cake
Hargreaves' vast pink fellow who eats the lot and eyes up your plate too
Blue star-shaped Hargreaves chap from chilly Coldland; one sudden red-nosed achoo
Where world leaders meet, and where a climber runs out of mountain
Glass-sided glow you hang from a ridgepole once dusk falls
Blue cloud of a Hargreaves fellow who whisks a boy off to far lands; a waking fancy
Sprawling metropolis of the Red Fort, India Gate and endless honking traffic
Hargreaves chap from Nonsenseland who paints red leaves green to win a cup; daft
Nylon room on poles, pitched for a night in a field
Little Miss so small she lives in a mousehole at Home Farm; minute indeed
